step1_analysis.circuit_type: Single-ended to Differential Current Converter / Class-AB Pre-driver
step1_analysis.description: This circuit converts a single-ended input voltage into two complementary output currents (one sourcing, one sinking). It is typically used as a phase splitter or pre-driver to control the push-pull output stage of a class-AB amplifier.

paper_reference.title: A 3.3-V CMOS Adaptive Analog Video Line Driver With Low Distortion Performance

Transconductance_1.description: Small-signal transconductance from the input to the sinking output (LABEL_NET_1).

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported for this sub-block

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using standard square-law model for SKY130 NMOS parameters at 1.8V supply.

Transconductance_2.description: Small-signal transconductance from the input to the sourcing output (LABEL_NET_2).

sky130_expected.calculation: Mirrors the current from XM1 via the PMOS current mirror (XM4/XM3). Assuming 1:1 mirror ratio, Gm2 should closely match Gm1.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetry with Gm1, though slightly degraded by the PMOS mirror pole.

Bandwidth.description: Frequency at which the transconductance drops by 3dB.

paper_reported.value: 5 MHz (for full driver linearity), 300 MHz (unity gain freq)

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole is at node N1. Cg ≈ 2 * W * L * Cox ≈ 25 fF. Rout ≈ 1 / gm_pmos ≈ 3 kOhm. fp = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cg) ≈ 2 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: This internal pre-driver stage is much faster than the overall closed-loop amplifier driving a heavy 75-ohm load.

Power_Consumption.description: DC power consumed by the circuit from the VDD supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Current from VDD flows through XM3 and XM4. I_total = 2 * 105 uA = 210 uA. Power = 1.8V * 210 uA = 378 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: This is a small sub-block, so its power is a fraction of the total 26.4 mW reported in the paper.

Output_Current_Swing.description: Peak-to-peak output current for a given input voltage swing (e.g., 0.2Vpp).

sky130_expected.calculation: Iout_pp = Gm * Vin_pp = 750 uA/V * 0.2 V = 150 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Demonstrates the large-signal current driving capability of the phase splitter.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure transconductance, bandwidth, power consumption, and output current swing of the class-AB pre-driver.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Class-AB Pre-driver Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VN0 N0 0 0
VN2 N2 0 dc 0.7 ac 1 sin(0.7 0.1 5Meg)

XM1 N1 N2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 LABEL_NET_1 N2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 LABEL_NET_2 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

.control
* DC Analysis for Power
op
let pwr = -i(VVDD)*1.8
print pwr

* AC Analysis for Gm and Bandwidth
ac dec 20 1k 10G
let gm1_mag = mag(i(VLABEL_NET_1))
let gm2_mag = mag(i(VLABEL_NET_2))
meas ac gm1_lowfreq find gm1_mag at=10k
meas ac gm2_lowfreq find gm2_mag at=10k

let gm1_3db = gm1_lowfreq * 0.7071
let gm2_3db = gm2_lowfreq * 0.7071
meas ac bw1 when gm1_mag=gm1_3db fall=1
meas ac bw2 when gm2_mag=gm2_3db fall=1

* Transient Analysis for Swing
tran 1n 1u
meas tran iout1_max max i(VLABEL_NET_1)
meas tran iout1_min min i(VLABEL_NET_1)
let iout1_pp = iout1_max - iout1_min
print iout1_pp

meas tran iout2_max max i(VLABEL_NET_2)
meas tran iout2_min min i(VLABEL_NET_2)
let iout2_pp = iout2_max - iout2_min
print iout2_pp

quit
.endc
